result.topic_en: Euler gives recursive logarithmic formulas for computing the terms I to XX of the series Q in terms of log t, and the corresponding terms of the series Q' as fixed fractions of them, and then begins to try out values of t, which he had previously shown to be less than 266.

items.english: since in the preceding dissertation we have shown that this number t is certainly less than 266
